# Enumerate signed-radius candidates on both rays of θ = π/6 and θ = 7π/6,

cands = []
for theta in (math.pi / 6, 7 * math.pi / 6):
    c = math.cos(2 * theta)
    if c <= TOL:
        continue
    r = math.sqrt(8 / c)
    for rho in (r, -r):

# Convert to Cartesian and keep only points satisfying both curve equations
valid = []

t2 = (-float(B) - disc) / (2 * float(A))
